items.raw_excerpt: Tres tardes, varias historias que escuchar y una realidad que muchas familias conocen demasiado bien.
items.summary_en: A small village in Leon, Spain set aside one week to care for neighbors who are losing their memory. Families and volunteers visited them to keep them company and offer support. The effort aims to raise awareness about dementia in the area.

items.raw_excerpt: Authorities are attempting to tag sharks lured to one of Perth's most popular beaches by a whale carcass, as they try to figure out how to transport the 10-metre specimen to landfill.
items.summary_en: Workers are tagging sharks that came to a Perth beach to feed on a dead whale. The whale is 10 metres long and lies on the sand. The council says it will cost a lot of money to move the whale to a dump.

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan's men's 4x100-meter relay team won silver at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Monday night, winning Taiwan's first medal in an Asian Games relay since 2010 while breaking the national record in the event with a time of 38.32 seconds.
items.summary_en: Taiwan's men's 4x100-meter relay team won silver at the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya. They set a new national record of 38.32 seconds, their first relay medal since 2010.

items.raw_excerpt: A contar de diciembre, todos los ciclistas que ingresen al cerro San Cristóbal deberán estar inscritos en un registro obligatorio del Parque Metropolitano (Parquemet) y portar un chaleco reflectante con un código identificatorio visible. La medida, impulsada por el Ministerio de Vivienda y Urbanismo (Minvu), busca fiscalizar los excesos de velocidad en las rutas del recinto y resguardar la seguridad de los peatones. El anuncio se da en medio del debate por la convivencia vial entre los deportist
items.summary_en: Starting in December, every cyclist entering San Cristobal hill in Santiago must sign up in a registry run by the city park. Riders also need to wear a reflective vest with a visible ID code. The rules aim to slow down speeders and protect people walking in the park.
items.summary_ko: 12월부터 산티아고 산크리스토발 언덕에 들어가는 모든 자전거 이용자는 도시 공원 관리 명부에 등록해야 합니다. 또한 식별 코드가 보이는 반사 조끼를 입어야 합니다. 이 규칙은 과속을 막고 공원을 걷는 사람을 지키기 위한 것입니다.
items.title_en: New Cycling Rules at San Cristobal Hill in Santiago
